subject.title: feat(clickclack): session discussions — bound channels, side agent, lifecycle sync

question: Should plugins receive a general public API to grant cross-session visibility, or should the exception be restricted to a discussion-specific, core-validated binding contract?
rationale: This determines the permanent authorization boundary for all current and future plugins; the PR cannot safely choose that boundary by itself.

options.title: Narrow the grant to discussion bindings
options.body: Move the authorization decision behind a discussion-owned contract that verifies the active provider binding, requester, target, action, and exact session incarnation before core grants access.

options.title: Adopt a general privileged plugin capability
options.body: Keep the generic registry only with an explicit privileged capability and documented trust model that makes the cross-session authorization bypass intentional.

options.title: Defer side-agent relay
options.body: Land only channel lifecycle and read-only discussion behavior, then design scoped relay access separately.

recommendation.title: Narrow the grant to discussion bindings
recommendation.body: Move the authorization decision behind a discussion-owned contract that verifies the active provider binding, requester, target, action, and exact session incarnation before core grants access.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns both the merged generic discussion seam and the proposed scoped-access integration.
